name: std::iostream_category
intro: Obtains a reference to the static error category object for iostream errors. The object is required to override the virtual function error_category::name() to return a pointer to the string "iostream". It is used to identify error codes provided in the exceptions of type std::ios_base::failure.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the static object of unspecified runtime type, derived from std::error_category.

examples.output:
